title: The Father of Shmuel bar Avin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Sanhedrin 51b, but Hyman says the reading should be “the father of R' Avin.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Sanhedrin 51b has the father of Shmuel bar Avin. The alternative “father of Rabbi Avin” is Hyman’s proposed correction; no identification with the father of the well-known Shmuel is imposed.

The saved Davidson Sanhedrin51b scalar has the father of Shmuel bar Avin, matching the supplied heading chain. Father of R' Avin is Hyman’s proposed emendation, with its should-be force retained; its abbreviated title stays R'. No familiar Shmuel identity or authority merge is imposed. The earlier note’s full Rabbi in Hyman’s conjectural alternative is unsupported by that witness; the supplied abbreviation remains R'.
